title: Prefetch-Steered Routing: Deterministic Cache-Aware Expert Selection for Offloaded Mixture-of-Experts Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.34721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model does not fit in GPU memory, batch-1 decoding is dominated by copying expert weights from host memory. Cache-aware routing reduces these copies by biasing the router toward resident experts, but combined with asynchronous prefetching it makes the model's outputs depend on transfer timing, so a harness that does not simulate that timing no longer evaluates the deployed model. We propose prefetch-steered routing (PSR): routing conditions on a deterministic logical cache, into which at most n experts predicted by the next layer's router are inserted per layer and token; physical copies affect only latency. On OLMoE-1B-7B with 50% and 25% of experts resident on an RTX 4090, PSR decodes 2.2-2.3x faster than exact routing with LRU and 25-30% faster than the Cache-Prior operating point, with mean benchmark differences of +0.1 and +0.5 points (95% lower bounds -0.8 and -0.3). translated_title: 预取导向路由：面向卸载式混合专家解码的确定性缓存感知专家选择
translated_abstract: 当混合专家模型无法完全装入GPU显存时，批量大小为1的解码过程主要由从主机内存复制专家权重所占据。缓存感知路由通过使路由器偏向常驻专家来减少这些复制操作，但与异步预取结合使用时，它会使模型输出依赖于传输时序，因此不模拟该时序的评估框架将无法再评估实际部署的模型。我们提出预取导向路由（PSR）：路由基于一个确定性的逻辑缓存进行，每层每个token最多插入由下一层路由器预测的n个专家；物理复制仅影响延迟。在RTX 4090上，当OLMoE-1B-7B分别有50%和25%的专家常驻时，PSR比使用LRU的精确路由解码快2.2-2.3倍，比Cache-Prior工作点快25-30%，平均基准测试差异分别为+0.1和+0.5分（95%置信下界分别为-0.8和-0.3）。在贪婪生成中，其领先优势……
tldr: 提出预取导向路由（PSR），使专家选择基于确定性的逻辑缓存而非物理传输时序，在专家卸载的MoE模型解码中实现2.2-2.3倍加速，同时保持与精确路由几乎一致的输出质量，并确保评估结果可离线复现。
en_tdlr: Prefetch-Steered Routing (PSR) conditions expert selection on a deterministic logical cache rather than physical transfer timing, achieving 2.2-2.3x faster decoding for offloaded MoE models while preserving output parity with exact routing and enabling offline-reproducible evaluation.
